title: Elder Vimala: Avoid evil friends, associate with the noble ones. Follow their advice, incline toward unshakable happiness. Like climbing a small plank on the ocean,…
content:
Elder Vimala:

Avoid evil friends, associate with the noble ones.
Follow their advice, incline toward unshakable happiness.

Like climbing a small plank on the ocean, one sinks;
So too, one of good conduct sinks when associating with others.
Therefore avoid the lazy, the indolent.

Live near the noble ones, the secluded, the energetic,
Meditative, always striving, the wise and clear-sighted.

title: Bhikkhus, if anyone were to say: 'A complete snare of Māra,' he would rightly say that of women. Truly, 'a complete snare of Māra' —…
content: Bhikkhus, if anyone were to say: 'A complete snare of Māra,' he would rightly say that of women. Truly, 'a complete snare of Māra' — that is what women are.

title: Friends, what is pursuit of the past? 'My eye in the past was such and such, forms were such and such, and consciousness there was…
content: Friends, what is pursuit of the past? 'My eye in the past was such and such, forms were such and such, and consciousness there was bound by desire and craving.' Because consciousness is bound by desire and craving, he delights in that. Delighting in that, he pursues the past. 'My ear in the past was such and such, sounds were such and such... My nose in the past was such and such, odors were such and such... My tongue in the past was such and such, flavors were such and such... My mind in the past was such and such, mental objects were such and such, and consciousness there was bound by desire and craving.' Because consciousness is bound by desire and craving, he delights in that. Delighting in that, he pursues the past. Thus, friends, is pursuit of the past.

title: The Blessed One: From these causes, desire and ill-will arise; From them arise liking and disliking, and fear. From them arise the thoughts of the…
content:
The Blessed One:
From these causes, desire and ill-will arise;
From them arise liking and disliking, and fear.
From them arise the thoughts of the mind.
Like children releasing a crow, they go.

The identification with a self arises from affection,
Like a banyan tree from its trunk.
The manifold bonds of sensual pleasures are spread,
Like a maluva creeper in the forest.

Those who know whence it arises
Remove its root. They cross this flood,
So hard to cross, not crossed before,
And do not come to renewed existence.

title: Ambattha, just as a young partridge can sing freely in its nest. Ambattha, Kapilavatthu belongs to the Sakya clan. It is not fitting for Ambattha…
content: Ambattha, just as a young partridge can sing freely in its nest. Ambattha, Kapilavatthu belongs to the Sakya clan. It is not fitting for Ambattha to be displeased over such a trivial matter.

title: How, Ānanda, is it that four foundations of mindfulness, when developed and cultivated, perfect the seven factors of enlightenment? Whenever, Ānanda, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating…
content: How, Ānanda, is it that four foundations of mindfulness, when developed and cultivated, perfect the seven factors of enlightenment? Whenever, Ānanda, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body as a body, his mindfulness is established; at that time, Ānanda, a bhikkhu is mindful, not forgetful. Whenever, Ānanda, a bhikkhu abides mindful, not forgetful, then the mindfulness enlightenment factor is aroused in that bhikkhu. Whenever, Ānanda, a bhikkhu develops the mindfulness enlightenment factor, then, through development, the mindfulness enlightenment factor comes to fulfillment. Abiding thus mindful, he wisely investigates, examines, and contemplates that Dhamma.

title: Bhikkhus, I say that almsfood is of two kinds: to be used and not to be used — thus it has been said. For what…
content: Bhikkhus, I say that almsfood is of two kinds: to be used and not to be used — thus it has been said. For what reason is it said? Here, if one knows of a certain almsfood: 'This almsfood, when I use it, unwholesome states increase and wholesome states decrease' — then such almsfood should not be used. Here, if one knows of a certain almsfood: 'This almsfood, when I use it, unwholesome states decrease and wholesome states increase' — then such almsfood should be used.

title: The Blessed One: Having seen craving, discontent, and greed, There can be no desire for sexual intercourse. Why would I desire this thing Full of…
content:
The Blessed One:
Having seen craving, discontent, and greed,
There can be no desire for sexual intercourse.
Why would I desire this thing
Full of urine and excrement, which I would touch with my foot?

title: Bhikkhus, the Dhamma has been well taught by me, made manifest, opened up, shown, and stripped of its old wrappings. Because the Dhamma has been…
content: Bhikkhus, the Dhamma has been well taught by me, made manifest, opened up, shown, and stripped of its old wrappings. Because the Dhamma has been well taught by me, made manifest, opened up, shown, and stripped of its old wrappings, for those bhikkhus who are Arahants, with taints destroyed, who have lived the holy life, done what had to be done, laid down the burden, reached the goal, destroyed the fetters of existence, liberated by final knowledge — the cycle of rebirth cannot be traced for them.

title: Elder Nun Anopamā: Born in a high family, With many jewels and riches, Complete with beautiful complexion, Majjha's beloved daughter. Courted by a king's son,…
content:
Elder Nun Anopamā:

Born in a high family,
With many jewels and riches,
Complete with beautiful complexion,
Majjha's beloved daughter.

Courted by a king's son,
Asked in marriage by a rich man's son,
Messengers came to my father:
'Give me Anopamā.'

The princess, your daughter,
Weigh her — how much is she worth?
I will give eight times
That amount in pure gold and jewels.

I saw the Awakened One,
The Blessed One, unsurpassed,
I bowed at his feet,
Approached and sat to one side.

Out of compassion, Gotama
Taught me the Dhamma.
Right there on that seat,
I attained the third fruit.

Then I shaved my hair,
Went forth into homelessness.
Today, on the seventh night,
Craving has been washed away.
